sn37.6:1.1: pañcahi anuruddha dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
sn37.6:1.3: assaddho ca hoti ahiriko ca hoti anottappī ca hoti opanāhī ca hoti duppañño ca hoti.
sn37.6:1.4: imehi kho anuruddha pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjatīti.
